sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', d.date)::date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats d WHERE d.route_id = '46' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'HTX-ThanhSon' GROUP BY ds ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: Retrieves the sum of total passengers (y) aggregated by year (ds) for route 46 operated by HTX-ThanhSon.
